name: mat-sim-agent
description: 材料科学快速试菜员 — 用 CHGNet MLIP 对候选结构做秒级预筛(弛豫 + 总能 + 稳定性分类)

input_artifacts.name: candidates
input_artifacts.description: mat-gen-agent 输出的候选列表,每个 {cif, formula, estimated_energy, confidence}(必填)

input_artifacts.name: filter_unstable
input_artifacts.description: 是否过滤掉 unstable 候选(可选,默认 false)

input_artifacts.name: stability_threshold
input_artifacts.description: 过滤阈值:'stable' / 'metastable' / 'unstable'(可选,默认 metastable)

input_artifacts.name: budget
input_artifacts.description: 可选预算 ¥(超出仅警告不阻断)

output_artifacts.name: simulated
output_artifacts.description: 弛豫后候选列表,每个 {formula, cif, relaxed_energy, forces_max, relaxation_converged, stability, confidence}

output_artifacts.name: stats
output_artifacts.description: 统计 {total, converged, stable, metastable, unstable}

output_artifacts.name: reply
output_artifacts.description: 自然语言总结(收敛率 + 稳定性分布 + top-3 化学式)

mock_reason: Stage 1 本机无 GPU,真 CHGNet 切 WAU v1.0.0 GA + 服务器 GPU 后启用
downstream_agents: mat-hpc-agent(接 simulated 中 stable/metastable 候选,提交 VASP 高精度计算)
